issues.criterion: build-rules [visual] 'forms have visible solid-border inputs + labels' / design-language §5 (inputs radius 4px)
issues.evidence: fp-claret-finance-full.png / fp-teal-finance-full.png: the 'Send us a message' form uses underline-style inputs (bottom hairline only, uppercase eyebrow labels YOUR NAME/PHONE/EMAIL/MESSAGE) rather than 4-sided boxed 4px-radius inputs. Fields are visible, labeled and legible on BOTH brands (no invisible text, no dark-locked inputs) and fit the theme's hairline grammar — so not a legibility failure, but a deviation from the boxed-input spec.
issues.fix_hint: Acceptable as-is (intentional hairline grammar). If strict §5 compliance is wanted, add a 1px var(--color-border) box + 4px radius to inputs. Does not block ship.

notes: Flow matches §7: page-ribbon(surface) -> finance intro + 3 ledger-steps 01-03(bg) -> assurance strip 'representative example' card + disclaimer captions(surface) -> enquiry form card(bg) -> browse-by-make -> footer. Single ledger instance; no primary band (footer excluded). Legible on teal.
